gen-dafont-good-times-fs-quicksand: Commanding wide capitals up top, with chunky lowercase and a moderate swing between heavy and light strokes. Quicksand follows in rounded, bulb-like letters whose lines never flicker thick to thin, so it hushes the heading's weight.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-almendra: Good Times stretches out in wide geometric display letters, with a slight but clear modulation in its strokes. Almendra settles in beneath, dignified and deep-bodied.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-bree-serif: Literary in spirit, Bree Serif sets oversized lowercase beneath a heading that wears its softly shaded strokes with swagger. Good Times is built to announce, while the serif is built to be lingered over.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-port-lligat-sla: Good Times opens wide, geometric and commanding. Port Lligat Slab then takes over with portholed lowercase and curves left open to breathe, a traditional voice against that brushy, tempered heading.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-quando: Wide, geometric and loud. Good Times shows tempered strokes that never thin to hairlines, and Quando answers in a bookish, traditional manner, its sparse spacing and tall middle zone giving every word room.
gen-dafont-groovy-fs-amulya: Amulya brings a contemporary, modern body with generous gaps in its curves, under a friendly heading. Groovy, with its slit-closed c and shadow-free strokes, would be happiest given a bit more size than the text.
gen-dafont-groovy-fs-chillax: Chillax sprawls like spaghetti laid out in letters, relaxed and open, with curves that never quite close their loops. And Groovy, tightly closed and funky above it, makes the looseness below feel like a deliberate exhale.
gen-dafont-groovy-fs-plein: Friendly and a bit funky, Groovy narrows its c to a near-closed slit and loosens its lowercase spacing. Plein takes the reading from there, with a reliable, clean channel leading into each round letter.
gen-dafont-groovy-fs-roundo: Funky, loose and quirky up top. And where Groovy goes tall with its constant-width limbs, Roundo works quietly in the moderate lowercase, keeping every small counter unclogged.
gen-dafont-groovy-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans is contemporary and approachable. Groovy does its best work with closed, funky letters and a high lowercase, while Spline Sans shines at wide-open curves and strokes of identical weight.
